predicates.name: delegates
predicates.instructions: In this event, the agent hands a subtask to a subagent (a child agent).

predicates.name: runs_code
predicates.instructions: In this event, the agent runs code or a shell command in a sandbox.

predicates.name: discovers_tools
predicates.instructions: In this event, the agent looks up which tools exist or fetches a tool's definition before using it.

predicates.name: final_answer
predicates.instructions: This event is the model's final reply for the turn: it answers without calling any tool.

predicates.name: waits_for_human
predicates.instructions: This event pauses the run until a human approves a tool call or answers a question.
